## Change

Describe the user-visible change.

## Checks

- [ ] Lint, type checks and relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Check six screen widths, keyboard controls and reduced motion.
- [ ] If an app page used by the walkthrough changed, run `npm run walkthrough:capture` and update that step's `lastVerified` in `src/features/public/walkthrough.config.ts`.
- [ ] Screenshots contain only Demo workspace records, with no customer data.
- [ ] Review on the Vercel preview before promoting to production.
